services.desc: Watch real trip footage - bull sharks, blacktip, redfish, cobia & more. Like, share, and subscribe to see the latest action from Captain Brad's charters. New Smyrna Beach is the Shark Bite Capital of the World - and Captain Brad puts you right in the middle of the action. Watch real shark fishing footage from our charters just 5-10 miles offshore. Bull sharks, blacktip, spinner, hammerhead, and lemon sharks caught on camera. Captain Brad invites you to experience the best saltwater fishing New Smyrna Beach has to offer - deep sea, shark fishing, inshore, and more. Over 25 years of guiding experience on Florida waters.
